name: cf-static-guard
description: Cloudflare Worker guard that protects any static site behind OAuth

scripts.build: npm run build:login && npm run build:admin && npm run build:example && npm run sync-assets && npm run build:worker && npm run build:cli
scripts.dev: npm run build:login && npm run build:admin && npm run build:example && npm run sync-assets && npm run dev -w @cf-static-guard/guard-worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @cf-static-guard/guard-worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cf-static-guard/guard-worker && npm run typecheck -w @cf-static-guard/login-ui && npm run typecheck -w @cf-static-guard/admin-ui && npm run typecheck -w @enderrealmmc/cf-static-guard
